title: Cleaning the dishwasher filter
subtitle: GE GSD5560G00SS - there's no pull-out filter; clean these 3 spots

steps.text: Wait 20 minutes after a cycle (the heater is hot). Pull the lower rack all the way out.
DOME (part 504): pick out debris around it - glass, seeds, labels, bones.
MESH SCREEN (part 502): wipe with a damp sponge. Soft brush is fine. No scouring pads or harsh cleaners.
SPRAY ARM (part 501): spin it by hand; it should turn freely. Clear clogged holes with a toothpick.
steps.source: PartSelect diagram, part 501 (general care; not in this manual)

steps.text: Film or smell: run the longest cycle empty, no detergent; at 18-22 minutes pour 2 cups of white vinegar into the bottom.
Only if it rattles or won't drain: the dome is held by screws at the spray-arm hub. Power off first. The dome and screen are discontinued, so don't force them.
steps.source: Manual p. 11 (sump cover screws); PartSelect availability
